lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [serious] An enemy land battleship is advancing on the city. [urgent] Strip its armor, cut its tracks and kill the reactor before it arrives!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [excited] Reactor destroyed! The land battleship is finished. [proud] Outstanding work, all aircraft!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [grimly] The city has fallen... [sighs] All units, withdraw.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [commanding, arrogant] All batteries, open fire. [cold] Grind a path to the city.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] A land battleship is moving on the city! Strip its armor plates, then go for the tracks!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [focused] Armor plate down! The track behind it is exposed!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [angry, shouting] Half our tracks are gone! Keep moving, full power to the rest!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [encouraging] Half its tracks are destroyed! It is losing speed!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [alarmed] Exhaust ducts exposed! [shouting] Seal them, now!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [focused] Those glowing vents behind the tracks are its weak point. Destroy them!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [encouraging] Half its exhaust vents are gone! Keep at it!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [panicked] Reactor overheating! [shouting] Open the core shutters!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [excited, urgent] The shutters on top are open! The core is exposed, hit it with everything you have!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [strained, through gritted teeth] Core integrity at fifty percent! Hold together!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [excited] The core is failing! Keep hitting it!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] Three kilometers to the city!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [very urgent] It is almost at the city limits! Stop it now!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [laughs menacingly] Nothing can stop us now!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [desperate, shouting] Five hundred meters! Bring it down!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [terrified] The reactor... [gasps] it is going critical!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [triumphant] Core destroyed! The battleship is going up!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [cold, satisfied] We have reached the city. [cruel] Commence bombardment.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [horrified] It is inside the city... [shaken] It is shelling the city!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [barking orders] Damage control, bring the batteries back online!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [warning] Some of its guns are back online. Watch yourselves!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: All aircraft. A single enemy ace is inbound. [uneasy] Something about that aircraft is not right. [cautious] Engage with caution.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [relieved] The ace is down and the missile is gone. [proud] Outstanding work, all aircraft!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [devastated, quietly] The missile hit the base... [sighs] All units, withdraw.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alert] Single bogey, closing fast. It is carrying a directed-energy weapon. [urgent] Do not sit in front of its nose!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, reverent] Launch authority confirmed. [softly] One warhead ends this war... and every border with it.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alarmed] Ground launch detected! A ballistic missile is climbing out of a silo. [urgent] Its target is our base!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [focused, urgent] The warhead is slaved to that ace's fire control. Shoot the ace down and the missile dies with it!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [strained] Heavy jamming! You can only get a lock from its front. [warning] Go head-on, and watch that laser!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [quietly mocking] Come at me head-on, [pause] if you still think your flag is worth dying for.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] Two minutes to impact!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, almost gentle] Two minutes. After that, there will be no nations left to fight over.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent, shouting] One minute! Bring that ace down!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [weary, sincere] Why keep fighting? In one minute, this war ends whether you win or not.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [desperate] Thirty seconds! It is now or never!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [whispers, melancholic] Thirty seconds. Take one last look at the world they taught you to divide.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [triumphant, relieved] The ace is down! The missile lost guidance... it detonated in the upper atmosphere!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [stunned, quietly] Impact... [devastated] The base is gone.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [serene, quietly] It's done. [sighs] No more borders... no more war.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, solemn] Every border down there was drawn by a war. [quiet conviction] I'm here to fire the shot that erases them all.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [amused, taunting softly] Catch me if you can still find a border to stand on.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [pained, fading] You'll just draw the lines again... [sad] and fight over them... [whispers] forever...

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alert] Two bogeys in tight formation... [intrigued] They're aces, and they fly like brothers. [warning] Expect decoys. Make sure you're locking the real one!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [excited] Both aces are down! [lighthearted] Heads or tails, it doesn't matter now. Good work!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [confident, smooth] Heads and Tails, on station. [smirking] Let's see which side you land on.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [cool, playful] One toss for each of you. [smug] Heads, I win.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [dry humor] Every coin has two faces. [condescending] You picked the wrong one.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [cold, serious] You've earned my full attention. [menacing] You won't enjoy it.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [pained, struggling] Tails... finish the toss... [fading] without me...

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [shocked] Tails...? [cold fury] You took my little brother. [quiet rage] The game is over. Now I just win.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, commanding] Tails. Flip.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [excited, playful] Brother, save a few for me this time!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [teasing] Catch! [laughs] ...Oh, can't catch them all? [mockingly] Shame!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [mischievously] Guess which one's me! [giggles] Go on, flip for it!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [surprised, annoyed] Hey! That actually hurt!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [shocked, fading] Heads... [sad] I called it wrong...

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [screaming, furious] You shot down my brother?! [crying, angry] No more coin tosses... [shouting] I'm taking every one of you down!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [gleeful] Call it, pilots!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alert] Four bandits, tight diamond. [tense] Shade squadron... [warning] They'll stall right in front of you. Don't sit on their tails, and they can fire in any direction!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [triumphant] Shade squadron is wiped out! [proud] Outstanding flying, all aircraft!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [cold, calm] Shade flight, engage. [quietly, menacing] Let them chase shadows.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [flat, crisp] Two.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [flat, crisp] Three.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [flat, crisp] Four.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [cold, smug] Overshoot. [quietly] Your mistake.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [sharp command] Shades, break and cross!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [tense, controlled] Shade One is down. [cold] Close it up.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [tense, controlled] Shade Two is down. [cold] Close it up.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [tense, controlled] Shade Three is down. [cold] Close it up.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [tense, controlled] Shade Four is down. [cold] Close it up.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, fading] Shade One... [whispers] going dark.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, fading] Shade Two... [whispers] going dark.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, fading] Shade Three... [whispers] going dark.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, fading] Shade Four... [whispers] going dark.

lines.speaker: betty
lines.text: Pull up. Pull up.

lines.speaker: betty
lines.text: Altitude. Altitude.

lines.speaker: betty
lines.text: Railgun warning.

lines.speaker: betty
lines.text: Laser warning.

lines.speaker: betty
lines.text: Damage critical.

lines.speaker: betty
lines.text: Stall. Stall.

lines.speaker: betty
lines.text: Flares empty.

lines.speaker: betty
lines.text: Bingo fuel.

lines.speaker: betty
lines.text: Ammunition zero.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alert] All aircraft. An enemy ace is circling over the city, [tense] and she is painting it with a laser. [urgent] Something is coming down from orbit. Stop her!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [relieved] The strike missed the city! [proud] Outstanding work, all aircraft!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [devastated, quietly] The city has been hit... [sighs] All units, withdraw.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [calm, almost tender] The city is lit. [soft, cold] All that is left... is for the sky to fall.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [serene, commanding] Little moons... rise. [cold, protective] Keep them away from me.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alarmed] She has launched interceptor drones! They will shoot down missiles near her. [focused] Kill the drones first, or fire everything at once!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [excited] All drones are down! She is wide open, [shouting] hit her now!

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [irritated sigh] Again, little moons. [softly, firm] Rise.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [warning] She is launching a second wave of drones!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] Two minutes until the strike!

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [amused, condescending] Two minutes. [leaning in, intimate] Look up... [cold] and remember how small you are.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent, shouting] One minute! Bring her down!

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [serene, smiling] One minute. [quiet confidence] The light never misses.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [desperate] Thirty seconds! Do it now!

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [whispering, gentle] Thirty seconds. [tender, cold] Close your eyes.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [triumphant, relieved] LUNA is down! The beam is gone... the strike has lost its target!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [stunned, quietly] Impact on the city... [devastated] It is gone.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [melancholic, softly] And the night... [sighs] falls quiet.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [dreamy, almost tender] The city is so bright tonight... [soft laugh] [cold, whispering] Let me make it brighter.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [gasps, shocked] No... [trembling, fading] So this... [sad, quietly] is what falling feels like...

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [softly, almost sweet] Stay right there... [cold, whispering] I'll make it quick... and beautiful.

lines.speaker: luna
lines.text: [playful, teasing] Not yet... [cold] You don't get to touch me.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [calm, professional] Copy your mark. Bomber inbound.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [focused] Bomb away.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [satisfied] Impact. Good effect on target.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [calm] Tanker drone en route. Hold steady.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [calm] Contact.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [relaxed] Transfer complete. Clear to break.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [urgent] Breakaway, breakaway! Tanker is returning.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [calm, confident] Guardian drone on station. Missile defense active.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [calm] Guardian drone returning to base.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Fox two.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Fox three.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Rifle.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Magnum.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Greyhound.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Bruiser.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Pickle.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Rockets away.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Music on.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Spear.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [crisp, calm] Drive, drive.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [smooth, amused] Coin's still in the air.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [excited, teasing] Ooh, shiny! [giggles] Your missile likes those better!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, quietly amused] You're aiming at a line that isn't there.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [cold, calm] You locked a shadow.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, professional] All batteries, open fire. We reach the city by nightfall.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [focused, urgent] Exhaust vents exposed! They're tucked inside the track wells, glowing blue. Destroy them and cripple that thing!

lines.speaker: crew
lines.text: [panicked, coughing] Captain, it's sixty degrees down here!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [cold, clipped] Then sweat. Divert all coolant to the reactor.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [excited, urgent] The core is exposed! Hit it with everything you have!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [flat, eerily calm] Seal the bulkheads. [pause] With them inside.

lines.speaker: crew
lines.text: [banging on metal, screaming] Open the door! Please, we're burning!

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: [synthetic, monotone] Crew unresponsive. Automated fire control engaged.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alarmed] Every gun is back on automatic! Stay on the core!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [strained, voice cracking] Override the safeties! We are NOT stopping!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [calm, almost peaceful] Reactor critical. [pause] All hands... [breaking] all hands, keep moving forward-

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [exhausted, hollow] We made it. It cost everything. [cold] Commence bombardment.

lines.speaker: system
lines.text: [synthetic] Battery restored.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [commanding, urgent] Reroute reactor power to the batteries. [shouting] All of them. Now!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [shouting, desperate] Keep firing! Keep fir—

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alarmed, urgent] It's feeding reactor power to its guns! Every battery is back! Stay on the core!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [screaming in agony] AAAAAAHHHH!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [alert] New contact, single bandit, unknown type! [tense] He's coming out of the sun. [urgent] Watch your missiles!

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [triumphant] The enemy ace is down! [proud] Outstanding flying, all aircraft!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [old, aristocratic, slow and measured] You trespass on land my family has held for three centuries. [calm, dignified resolve] I shall see you off it myself.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [old gentleman, amused, unhurried] Follow me into the light... [quietly] if you dare.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [old aristocrat, warm pride] The sun has always favoured my house.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [old, softly amused] Your missile bows to the sun. [dignified] As it should.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [old gentleman, mild reproach] Manners, young one. [calm, firm] One does not shoot a gentleman in the back.

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [old, polite, dry] Too slow, I'm afraid.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [confused, then amazed] He's hit, but nothing vital! [disbelief] He keeps turning his engines and cockpit away from our fire. [stunned] He's doing damage control by flying!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [old, deep, weary pride] There are pilots like you in every generation. [slow, cold certainty] And I've felled every last one of them.

lines.speaker: awacs
lines.text: [shocked, shouting] He turned on a dime! [urgent warning] Don't chase him into the sun!

lines.speaker: enemy
lines.text: [old, strained, then peaceful] Ah... [quiet, accepting] it seems the time has come... [softly] to pass it on to the next generation.
